notes.title: Update v1.21
notes.content:
1.lock frame rate at 144, bigger value may cause cpu overheat

2.fix a bug cause player can't reach max speed when frame rate was  too low.

3.display soul number in left down corner

4.add "Screen Space Ambient Occlusion" ssao effect, and performance drop is very low(at least in my computer)

notes.title: Major Update v1.20
notes.content:
0.Remake hole map into a much bigger and better looking version.

1.Skeletons now have footsteps and spawn sound fx.

2.Some minor changes to the player controller script, gives a more natural & smooth control. for example, player now almost immediately stopped after grounded, and also need a acceleration to reach max speed.

3.change fov to 90.

4.delete "speed x1.5" random drop

notes.title: Major Update 1.1
notes.content:
0.Add a random drop system.
1.Add some skeleton monster skin, different skin with different speed.
2.Rewrite skeleton generate logic, game are more easy to play with now.
3.Game map are much brighter now.
4.Skeleton death sound effect, a wind sound add to the church too.
5.New menu background music.
6.Add shotgun mode to the main weapon,tap fire1 to shoot.

really busy these days, forgive my lazy update log.

notes.title: Update v1.01(2018.9.23)
notes.content:
Add:
1.Add crosshair
2.Add a hint to loading screen

Improvement:
1.Achievement now only need 130 souls to unlock all(original is 260)
2.Smaller muzzle flash
3.Better bullet impact particle
4.Auto submit score when player die
5.Auto match language with steam setting

Fix:
1.Remove slope from church, some players use this to cheat
